name: 到期管家
description: Track due dates and selected Apple Reminders with 11 due-item types, 130 offline SF Symbols, and private layered icon inference from reminder title, List, notes, then fallback.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 通过原生风格桌面组件管理 11 种到期事项，内置 130 个离线 SF Symbols，并按提醒标题、所属 List、备注和默认值分层识别图标，全程离线。
